boot_start.note: Quirk: /etc is an overlay mounted by the rc.d script S03mounts-ab after procd has listed /etc/rc.d/S*, so rc.d links added by 'enable' never run at boot. The package rayhunterwrt-host-inseego-fx4200 adds /etc/rc3.d/S99rayhunter, a one-line file that the vendor fakeinit manager evals at runlevel 3; the init script still starts nothing unless rayhunter.main.enabled is 1
